description: Searches Salesforce contacts by name, email, phone, account name, or title using partial matches. Multiple criteria are combined with OR; without criteria, it returns recent contacts up to the requested limit.

account_name.description: Search by associated account name. Supports partial matches.
account_name.human_parameter_description: Provide the company or account name the contact is associated with to narrow results. Partial names work too.
account_name.title: Account Name

email.description: Search by email address. Supports partial matches.
email.human_parameter_description: Enter the contact's email address or any part of it to find matches.
email.title: Email

fields.description: Comma-separated list of Contact fields to retrieve. Custom and non-default fields are excluded unless explicitly listed here.
fields.human_parameter_description: Choose which contact details to return. Keep the default for common info, or list the fields you need separated by commas.
fields.title: Fields

limit.description: Maximum number of contacts to return. Maximum allowed is 2000; when totalSize exceeds limit, paginate to retrieve full results.
limit.human_parameter_description: Set the maximum number of contacts to return. Lower values are faster; higher values show more results.
limit.title: Limit

name.description: Search by contact name (first name, last name, or full name). Supports partial matches.
name.human_parameter_description: Type the contact's name you want to find. You can use a full name or just part of the first or last name.
name.title: Name

phone.description: Search by phone number. Supports partial matches.
phone.human_parameter_description: Enter a phone number or part of it to search for contacts. This checks both main and mobile numbers.
phone.title: Phone

title.description: Search by job title. Supports partial matches.
title.human_parameter_description: Enter the contact's job title to filter your search, like Manager or Sales. Partial titles are okay.
title.title: Title
